== Summary ==
Before/after crops for [[One More Pass (PC Errata 2017 slip)]]. Compared with [[One More Pass (PC Errata 2017 disc card)]]. Lower part of the disc card (the area the slip covers, scaled to the slip's width) and the 2017 slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited. Made by placing the two crops side by side (Bill, 12 November 2026: every version article shows cropped screenshots of what changed).
